crossRefs.note: Seeing that many boast after the flesh, I will also boast.

translations.web: though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh. If any other man thinks that he has confidence in the flesh, I yet more:
translations.bsb: though I myself could have such confidence. If anyone else thinks he has grounds for confidence in the flesh, I have more:
translations.kjv: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh, I more:
translations.asv: though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh: if any other man thinketh to have confidence in the flesh, I yet more:
